K6 is missing entirely, as there is no mention of the planned EUR 7.1 million investment in 2026 for mobile network expansion, including construction of 50 new base stations, modernization of 300 existing sites, and upgrades to around 130 locations, with around 30 new base stations to be installed in 2027 under the state-funded RAIN program. K10 is also missing, as there is no mention of the appointment of Vaidas Dominauskas as Head of Enterprise (B2B) effective 1 July 2026. While several important details are present, the absence of K6 and K10, both of HIGH importance, results in a 'Generally yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: revenue growth drivers are clearly identified (S2-S3), profitability metrics are consistently presented (S4-S5), expense increases are explained with specific drivers (S7), and strategic investments are detailed with purpose and amounts (S13-S17). The narrative flows logically from financial performance to operational metrics to strategic positioning. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational problems. While there is a minor repetition of growth percentages (S2 vs S3), this does not materially reduce clarity. The summary forms a coherent whole that supports the concluding statement in S19.
